tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
创建笔记API
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记搜索功能
创建搜索前端页面

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database model for notes with fields like title, content, timestamp, and tags.
T1.notes: Ensure the model supports scalability and includes necessary indexes for search optimization.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes.
T2.notes: Implement authentication and validation for secure and reliable API usage.

T3.implementation_approach: Build a responsive front-end page using a framework like React or Vue to display and manage notes.
T3.notes: Incorporate user-friendly UI/UX elements for better usability.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement a search function using database queries or a search engine like Elasticsearch to filter notes by keywords or tags.
T4.notes: Optimize the search for performance and consider partial matching or fuzzy search.

T5.implementation_approach: Create a front-end search page with a search bar and results display, integrating it with the search API.
T5.notes: Provide real-time feedback or suggestions as users type in the search bar.
